summary: Phase 2 customer repair-request flow tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_repair_flow.py (15 tests) covering create (other charger + photos base64), REQUESTED->AWAITING_SHIPMENT transition, GET persistence, validation (missing brand 400, missing description 422, invalid charger_type 400, null type accepted), owner charger_id path, cross-customer 403, 404, unauth, plus regression (wallet, stations, sessions start/live/stop, owner & admin summaries). Full suite: 64 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed. Frontend (Playwright, 1400px + 390px): dashboard repair-charger-btn -> /repairs/new, existing wallet-card/scan-qr-btn/station-code-input/stations-map still render; form validation toasts (empty description, empty brand) block submission; photo upload previews + type/size rejection (txt, >5MB) works; submit -> repair-confirmation with REP-10043/10045, all required confirmation texts and no hardcoded address; view-repair-btn -> repair-detail-page with detail-number, detail-status 'Awaiting shipment', photos rendered; owner 'My Voltx Charger' path lists IND000001-6, shows selected-charger-info and creates repair with charger_id (REP-10044); second customer visiting customer A's repair sees friendly repair-error 'You don't have access to this repair request.'; mobile drawer (menu-btn) works.

minor.issue: Auto-fill sets charger_info.brand AND charger_info.model to the same station name (e.g. 'Koregaon Park Station') and leaves charger_type null, so the detail page shows duplicated Brand/Model and Type '—' for registered chargers. Cosmetic Phase-1 behaviour.

issues: 'We repair EV chargers of any brand — retail & station chargers, AC, DC and portable.' breaks into 2-3 awkward columns on both desktop and mobile because the flex container (flex items-center gap-2) treats the text nodes / <b> as separate flex items. Wrap the sentence in a single <span>.
Tailwind classes h-4.5/w-4.5 (RepairNew lines 156/275) and h-13 (submit button, line 279) are not valid default Tailwind sizes and are silently ignored.

action_items: Optional polish: wrap the 'any brand' banner sentence in a single span so it renders as one paragraph.
Optional: replace invalid Tailwind sizes h-4.5/w-4.5/h-13 in RepairNew.jsx with valid ones (h-4 w-4 / h-12).
Lint: RepairNew.jsx:220 unescaped apostrophe in "What's wrong with your charger?" (react/no-unescaped-entities error).
Optional: for registered chargers avoid duplicating station name into both brand and model in POST /api/repairs auto-fill.
critical_code_review_comments: RepairNew.submit() swallows the failure of the PATCH /repairs/{id}/status AWAITING_SHIPMENT call silently; if it fails the request stays REQUESTED while the confirmation claims shipment is the next step. Consider surfacing a warning or performing the transition server-side on create.
RepairNew.jsx imports Badge and Upload but never uses them (dead imports).
Validation errors are only surfaced as sonner toasts (no inline field error / aria-invalid); acceptable but inline messages would be more accessible and easier to test.
seed_data_creation: Test repair requests created: REP-10043 (customer +919000000003, other charger + photo), REP-10044 (owner +919000000002, IND000001), REP-10045 (customer, 'Not sure' type), plus API-created TEST_* repairs which were set to CANCELLED by the test teardown. One throwaway customer (+9196xxxxxxxx, name TEST_CustB) and per-test +9197/+9198 customers were created for the 403 check. No delete endpoint exists for repair_requests, so UI-created REP-10043/44/45 remain in the DB.
test_credentials: OTP 123456; customer +919000000003, owner +919000000002, admin +919000000001. Note: the login demo buttons only prefill the phone and move to the OTP step — the test must fill otp-input with 123456 and click verify-otp-btn.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 flow is functionally complete and green. Backend regression suite lives in /app/backend/tests/ (backend_test.py, test_repairs.py, test_phase2_repair_flow.py). Note real session routes are POST /api/sessions/start, GET /api/sessions/{id}/live, POST /api/sessions/{id}/stop (no POST /api/sessions). Remaining items are cosmetic (banner text wrapping, invalid Tailwind size classes, lint apostrophe) and the silent status-transition fallback.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The banner layout issue is caused by using a flex row container for a sentence containing an inline <b>, which makes each text node a flex item.
